title: App Settings ON gives access to the admin pages
preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON and the App Settings sub-toggle ON.
steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open the Settings area in the left sidebar.
  3. Look for Departments, Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions and Locations.
expected: The App Settings pages are available: Departments, Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions and Locations.
